title: Login screen
description: The sign-in screen as the reference composition for a whole screen built from the contract: the shell's needle ground at the sidebar's 0.5rem margin carrying a bark-50 Card. The brand takes the ground (tagline and lede on the card's height, the photograph's credit in the corner); the form takes the card: CardHeader, two required Inputs, a Workspace Select, and a stacked CardFooter of primary Sign in, an or-divider, a secondary SSO button, a slotted tertiary link and fine print.

anatomy.description: Root with data-slot="login-screen": the ground gradient, its own inline-size container, so the two columns stack below 48rem of the screen's width, not the viewport's, and the card spans the width below 30rem.

The ground column, the card's height and centred with it: tagline (display-lg, bark-50, a p not a heading: the page's one heading is the card's title) and lede (text-lg, needle-100, 30ch). The ground's photograph (juniper branches and berries, Hansheng Zhao on Unsplash, loaded from the Unsplash CDN) covers the whole screen in luminosity blend at low opacity; the card covers its half. The credit link sits in the layout's bottom-right corner beneath the card (text-2xs, needle-100; bloom on hover, the sidebar's outline step on focus).
Private descendant: the juniper glyph as inline SVG JSX filling currentColor, so the entry ships without an asset.

The house Card as the inset: radius-md, no hairline, the form centred at 22rem, and the Mark quiet in its bottom-right corner (bark-200 at 50%, inside the padding box so the scrolling card draws no scrollbar).
react-aria Form with native validation: isRequired blocks the submit, the first empty field takes focus and FieldError shows the message; onSubmit hands the credentials to the caller.
CardTitle at level 1 (Sign in) over a CardDescription.
Email Input (type email, autocomplete username, autoFocus), Password Input (autocomplete current-password), Workspace Select with the plan as the list hint.

Stacked: the primary submit, an or-divider, the secondary Continue with SSO button (only with onSingleSignOn), the slotted secondaryAction (a discrete Button asChild around a router Link) and the fine print.

usage: A reference composition, not a reusable primitive: copy the structure (ground carrying a card, brand on the ground, form on the card, controls composed from Field) rather than the component.

Controlled: pass workspaces ({ id, name, plan }), an optional defaultWorkspaceId and onSignIn({ email, password, workspaceId }). The component never navigates; the route decides where a sign-in lands.
Pass onSingleSignOn to render the SSO button; leave it out and the divider goes with it. Pass the guest or sign-up link as secondaryAction so the router stays in the route.
The form lives on the card because the extruded controls only read on bark-50 (theming §4.6); never move fields onto the ground.
Validation is react-aria's native behaviour; do not add noValidate or an attempted-submit flag. Messages come through errorMessage on each Input.

The photograph is a url() to the Unsplash CDN in the module's CSS (licence noted in the module, credited under the mark through `copy.credit` / `copy.creditHref`), so the entry ships self-contained with no asset to copy; swap the URL and the credit together. Keep the blend and a low opacity: luminosity takes the ground's green so no colour outside the palette enters; at full opacity it washes the copy out.
Copy is overridable through `copy`, defaults in LOGIN_COPY. Keep the tagline a sentence: the voice is quiet and declarative.
The ground gradient and the card are mode-invariant; only the page canvas outside them changes with light-dark(), so both modes need no new decisions.
